grammar.pattern: 名词性谓语：年龄、日期等
grammar.explanation: 我二十二岁 and 今天星期三 can stand without 是 in familiar age/date contexts. This is not a rule to delete 是 from every identification: 她是商人 remains a normal noun classification. Negative age/date claims normally use 不是: 今天不是星期二. Ask what is being stated before expanding an omitted verb.

commonMistakes.wrong: 她商人。这里是在介绍身份。
commonMistakes.why: Keep 是 in this neutral identity introduction; short age/date patterns do not license every noun predicate.

grammar.purpose: Interpret topic, nominal predicate and scope
grammar.explanation: 今天星期三 has the topic 今天 and nominal predicate 星期三. 她今年二十二岁 states her age this year, not her birthday or birthplace. 这本书三十五块 gives a price in context. Use 不是 to reject a stated value and supply the actual one; these patterns do not establish unrelated facts.

examples.py: tā jīn nián èr shí èr suì .
zhè běn shū sān shí wǔ kuài .

examples.zh: 今天不是星期二，是星期三。
examples.py: jīn tiān bù shì xīng qī èr , shì xīng qī sān .
examples.en: Today is not Tuesday; it is Wednesday.

commonMistakes.wrong: 她今年二十二岁，所以知道生日是哪天。
commonMistakes.right: 她今年二十二岁，生日是哪天还没说。
commonMistakes.why: An age does not identify the birthday date.

lines.zh: 那我们下次去看看？我正好想买点茶。

lines.zh: 好。今天星期三，周六下午去吧。

reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 我找旧照片时，想起以前的小组只有三个人。现在有五位朋友一起读书，见面的地方也从小房间变成了活动中心。
lines.py: wǒ zhǎo jiù zhào piān shí , xiǎng qǐ yǐ qián de xiǎo zǔ zhǐ yǒu sān gè rén . xiàn zài yǒu wǔ wèi péng you yì qǐ dú shū , jiàn miàn de dì fāng yě cóng xiǎo fáng jiān biàn chéng le huó dòng zhōng xīn .
lines.en: Looking through old photos reminded me that our group once had only three people. Five of us now read together, and we'd moved from a small room to the activity centre.

lines.zh: 陈宇看照片，认出了自己以前的外套。我说姐姐也有一件，他就问姐姐现在做什么。我告诉他，她在市中心开了茶叶店。
lines.py: chén yǔ kàn zhào piān , rèn chū le zì jǐ yǐ qián de wài tào . wǒ shuō jiě jie yě yǒu yī jiàn , tā jiù wèn jiě jie xiàn zài zuò shén me . wǒ gào sù tā , tā zài shì zhōng xīn kāi le chá yè diàn .
lines.en: Chen Yu recognised his old coat in a photo. I said my sister had one like it, and he asked what she did now. She had a tea shop in the city centre.

lines.zh: 姐姐过去在南方长大，现在搬到这里。我去她店里看过，里面有许多小杯子，客人可以先坐下喝一点茶。
lines.py: jiě jie guò qù zài nán fāng zhǎng dà , xiàn zài bān dào zhè lǐ . wǒ qù tā diàn lǐ kàn guò , lǐ miàn yǒu xǔ duō xiǎo bēi zi , kè rén kě yǐ xiān zuò xià hē yī diǎn chá .
lines.en: My sister had grown up in the south and moved here. I'd visited her shop. It had lots of little cups, and customers could sit and taste some tea first.

lines.zh: 我们周三约好，周六三点在活动中心门口见。我把店的地址发给另外三位朋友，问她们要不要一起去。
lines.py: wǒ men zhōu sān yuē hǎo , zhōu liù sān diǎn zài huó dòng zhōng xīn mén kǒu jiàn . wǒ bǎ diàn de dì zhǐ fā gěi lìng wài sān wèi péng you , wèn tā men yào bù yào yì qǐ qù .
lines.en: On Wednesday we arranged to meet at the activity centre entrance at three on Saturday. I sent the shop address to the other three friends and asked if they'd like to join us.

lines.zh: 周六有一位朋友要上班，四个人一起去了。姐姐先拿来茶，陈宇选了一小袋，付款时才想起信用卡忘在家里。
lines.py: zhōu liù yǒu yī wèi péng you yào shàng bān , sì gè rén yì qǐ qù le . jiě jie xiān ná lái chá , chén yǔ xuǎn le yī xiǎo dài , fù kuǎn shí cái xiǎng qǐ xìn yòng kǎ wàng zài jiā lǐ .
lines.en: One friend had work on Saturday, so four of us went. My sister brought tea. Chen Yu chose a small bag and only remembered when paying that his credit card was at home.

lines.zh: 他用手机付了钱，我们又坐了一会儿。走以前，姐姐帮我们拍了照片；这次四个人站在一起，下次想五个人都来。
lines.py: tā yòng shǒu jī fù le qián , wǒ men yòu zuò le yī huì er . zǒu yǐ qián , jiě jie bāng wǒ men pāi le zhào piān ; zhè cì sì gè rén zhàn zài yì qǐ , xià cì xiǎng wǔ gè rén dōu lái .
lines.en: He paid by phone, and we stayed a while. My sister took a photo before we left. There were four of us this time; next time we hoped all five could come.

choices: Four friends visit the shop and take a photo

choices: The shop has only four cups

lines.en: Her voice changed and I didn't recognise her at first.

lines.en: The water slowly turned to ice.

lines.zh: 我得了第一名，特别开心。
lines.py: wǒ děi le dì yī míng , tè bié kāi xīn .
lines.en: I came first and was very happy.

lines.zh: 节日那天，到处都是人。
lines.py: jié rì nà tiān , dào chù dōu shì rén .
lines.en: There were people everywhere on the holiday.

lines.zh: 到车站以后，我们就分开走了。
lines.py: dào chē zhàn yǐ hòu , wǒ men jiù fēn kāi zǒu le .
lines.en: We went our separate ways after reaching the station.

lines.zh: 把新的书和旧的书分开放吧。
lines.py: bǎ xīn de shū hé jiù de shū fēn kāi fàng ba .
lines.en: Keep the new books separate from the old ones.

lines.zh: 比赛结果出来了。
lines.py: bǐ sài jié guǒ chū lái le .
lines.en: The competition result is out.

lines.zh: 我找了很久，结果笔一直在口袋里。
lines.py: wǒ zhǎo le hěn jiǔ , jié guǒ bǐ yì zhí zài kǒu dài lǐ .
lines.en: I searched for ages; in the end the pen had been in my pocket all along.

lines.zh: 你选一段，我选另一段。
lines.py: nǐ xuǎn yī duàn , wǒ xuǎn lìng yī duàn .
lines.en: You choose one section and I'll choose another.

lines.zh: 我想选靠窗的位子。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng xuǎn kào chuāng de wèi zi .
lines.en: I'd like a seat by the window.

lines.zh: 我想到一个好办法。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng dào yī gè hǎo bàn fǎ .
lines.en: I've thought of a good idea.

lines.zh: 想到她还没吃饭，我又买了一个包子。
lines.py: xiǎng dào tā hái méi chī fàn , wǒ yòu mǎi le yī gè bāo zi .
lines.en: I remembered she hadn't eaten and bought another bun.

lines.zh: 这张照片让我想起过去的朋友。
lines.py: zhè zhāng zhào piān ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ guò qù de péng you .
lines.en: This photo reminds me of old friends.

lines.zh: 我突然想起地址改了。
lines.py: wǒ tū rán xiǎng qǐ dì zhǐ gǎi le .
lines.en: I suddenly remembered the address had changed.

lines.zh: 她从南方的一个省来。
lines.py: tā cóng nán fāng de yī gè shěng lái .
lines.en: She's from a province in the south.

lines.zh: 这个省有许多山。
lines.py: zhè gè shěng yǒu xǔ duō shān .
lines.en: This province has many mountains.

lines.zh: 今天来了许多朋友。
lines.py: jīn tiān lái le xǔ duō péng you .
lines.en: Lots of friends came today.

lines.zh: 她给我看了许多照片。
lines.py: tā gěi wǒ kàn le xǔ duō zhào piān .
lines.en: She showed me many photos.

lines.zh: 十岁以上的孩子都可以参加。
lines.py: shí suì yǐ shàng de hái zi dōu kě yǐ cān jiā .
lines.en: Children aged ten and above can take part.

lines.zh: 活动需要五人以上才开始。
lines.py: huó dòng xū yào wǔ rén yǐ shàng cái kāi shǐ .
lines.en: The activity needs at least five people before it starts.

lines.zh: 请读以下三条安排。
lines.py: qǐng dú yǐ xià sān tiáo ān pái .
lines.en: Please read the following three arrangements.

lines.zh: 五岁以下的孩子坐在前面。
lines.py: wǔ suì yǐ xià de hái zi zuò zài qián miàn .
lines.en: Children aged five and under sit at the front.

lines.zh: 除了这本以外，我还借了两本。
lines.py: chú le zhè běn yǐ wài , wǒ hái jiè le liǎng běn .
lines.en: Besides this one, I borrowed two more books.

lines.zh: 名单以外的人可以坐后面。
lines.py: míng dān yǐ wài de rén kě yǐ zuò hòu miàn .
lines.en: People not on the list can sit at the back.

lines.zh: 她在这个城市长大。
lines.py: tā zài zhè gè chéng shì zhǎng dà .
lines.en: She grew up in this city.

lines.zh: 孩子又长高了一点。
lines.py: hái zi yòu zhǎng gāo le yī diǎn .
lines.en: The child has grown a little taller again.

lines.zh: 活动中心就在前面。
lines.py: huó dòng zhōng xīn jiù zài qián miàn .
lines.en: The activity centre is just ahead.

lines.zh: 市中心有一家新书店。
lines.py: shì zhōng xīn yǒu yī jiā xīn shū diàn .
lines.en: There's a new bookshop in the city centre.

lines.zh: 这个市有几个区。
lines.py: zhè gè shì yǒu jǐ gè qū .
lines.en: This city has several districts.

lines.zh: 我去年搬到这个市。
lines.py: wǒ qù nián bān dào zhè gè shì .
lines.en: I moved to this city last year.

lines.zh: 市长出席了开幕活动。
lines.py: shì zhǎng chū xí le kāi mù huó dòng .
lines.en: The mayor attended the opening event.

lines.zh: 今天的报纸介绍了新市长。
lines.py: jīn tiān de bào zhǐ jiè shào le xīn shì zhǎng .
lines.en: Today's newspaper introduces the new mayor.

lines.zh: 她是一位做茶叶生意的商人。
lines.py: tā shì yī wèi zuò chá yè shēng yì de shāng rén .
lines.en: She's a merchant in the tea trade.

lines.zh: 两位商人在店里谈了一会儿。
lines.py: liǎng wèi shāng rén zài diàn lǐ tán le yī huì er .
lines.en: Two businesspeople talked in the shop for a while.

lines.zh: 这里能用信用卡吗？
lines.py: zhè lǐ néng yòng xìn yòng kǎ ma ?
lines.en: Can I pay by credit card here?

lines.zh: 我把信用卡忘在家里了。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ xìn yòng kǎ wàng zài jiā lǐ le .
lines.en: I left my credit card at home.

lines.zh: 过去我住这里，现在住别处。
lines.py: guò qù wǒ zhù zhè lǐ , xiàn zài zhù bié chù .
lines.en: I used to live here; now I live elsewhere.

lines.zh: 她喜欢说起过去的事情。
lines.py: tā xǐ huān shuō qǐ guò qù de shì qíng .
lines.en: She likes talking about the past.

audio.zh: 行，三点在活动中心门口见，再一起坐车过去。
audio.py: xíng , sān diǎn zài huó dòng zhōng xīn mén kǒu jiàn , zài yì qǐ zuò chē guò qù .
audio.en: Okay. Meet at the activity centre entrance at three, then take the bus together.

tasks.statement: They meet at three at the activity centre entrance.
tasks.why: This detail is stated in the heard line.

audio.zh: 他用手机付了钱，我们又坐了一会儿。走以前，姐姐帮我们拍了照片；这次四个人站在一起，下次想五个人都来。
audio.py: tā yòng shǒu jī fù le qián , wǒ men yòu zuò le yī huì er . zǒu yǐ qián , jiě jie bāng wǒ men pāi le zhào piān ; zhè cì sì gè rén zhàn zài yì qǐ , xià cì xiǎng wǔ gè rén dōu lái .
audio.en: He paid by phone, and we stayed a while. My sister took a photo before we left. There were four of us this time; next time we hoped all five could come.

tasks.statement: All five friends appear in the new photo.
tasks.why: The heard line explicitly states a different result.

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 二48, 二54. Native check: nominal predicates in age/date/price contexts, inclusive 以上/以下 boundaries, 得 dé obtaining versus de complement particle, 长 zhǎng growing versus cháng long, 省 noun versus saving verb, and the original verse’s compressed wording. Scores are fictional scene facts, not app readiness claims. Planned retrieval 二35 / 二42 / 二36 / 二32 / 二71: 喂，你好，现在方便吗？, 有空的话，我来坐一会儿。, 不一会儿，她回了消息。, 这部影片我看过，但小说还没读。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Late HSK 2 correction: acquaintances reading a newspaper and planning New Year; a half-hour visit with the right novel and a forgotten scarf; painting an uncooperative cat and visiting an exhibition; old group photos and a sister’s tea shop. Removed app-policy/identity/medical-disclaimer leakage from ordinary speech and replaced metalinguistic word examples with independent situations. All target records get two authored contexts. Preserved old unit/word/task IDs. Native flags: suffix 家, 老/小 address forms, 等 list suffix, aspiration 成为/实现, result 成, scope of 以上/以下, 得 dé and 长 zhǎng, concrete medicine nouns 药片/药水 and subject 科. 画儿 remains subject to the explicit unresolved-audio policy, never native-reviewed. Check exact question facts, inclusive age bounds and the teasing tone. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
